data.narrative:
Peak Quantum is a pre-seed stage quantum computing company founded by Leon Koch (CEO) and team, which has raised €5M to date. The quantum computing sector includes a peer universe of 11 companies—3 public (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

The peer-median method is inapplicable due to insufficient comparable datapoints at the same or adjacent stage; the quantum computing peer set lacks three or more pre-seed or seed-stage equivalents with directly comparable valuation tiers, making sector-wide median benchmarking unreliable. Consequently, valuation relies on stage-progression analysis. Using the €5M total raised as a value proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for pre-seed to next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of €12M.

The triangulated range is €11M (low) to €14M (median €12M), derived from a single applicable methodology. The narrow method count reflects genuine data constraints rather than analytical choice. Key uncertainties include the absence of transaction comparables at Peak Quantum's stage and the reliance on a broad multiplier that may not account for sector-specific capital intensity, technical milestones, or founder track record not captured in available data. Further valuation refinement would require either additional pre-seed quantum company transactions or detailed technical/commercial diligence.
